rules.statement: A will that refers to a property being enjoyed by children and their descendants for as long as the law allows, creates a fidei commissum.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think there can be little doubt that it was the intention of the testatrix to impress a fidei commissum on the property, in the interest of the three children and their descendants, for such time as the law might allow to be possessed by them, and no others."
